brief: Goldman Sachs US equity sales daily note. Goldman forecasts August nonfarm payrolls at +40k against consensus of +55k, because big data indicators of job growth slowed sequentially and August initial prints have carried a consistent negative bias over the last decade, partly offset by low layoffs and scope for rebounds in leisure and hospitality and local education payrolls. It forecasts the unemployment rate unchanged at 4.1%, in line with consensus, on stabilizing continuing claims, and average hourly earnings up 0.4% month-over-month, above consensus, on calendar effects. Three single-stock updates follow. Lululemon posted a materially weaker 2Q and cut FY guidance, with China comps at -8% versus +13% in F1Q and leggings down 20% year over year, and management guides 3Q trend down again. Tyson cut FY26 EBIT guidance 11% at the midpoint on beef margin compression from cattle shortages, and Goldman came away more cautious on FY27 on chicken. Snowflake rose 21% on a 2Q beat and FY27 guidance implying growth accelerating to 36%, and Goldman maintains Buy. Thursday's tape: SPX +106bps to 7747, rates stabilizing after Waller backed a September hold, AI software outperforming AI semis after AVGO -2.7%.
